content.comment_body: Is it possible to connect my [product_name] [article_no] with [product_name] to create a SCADA project? I want to read both inputs and outputs of the controller, and not just timers and counters. Is full access to these signals possible? Additionally, can inputs and outputs be changed by sending network inputs from SCADA via [product_name]? I reviewed some manuals for connecting [product_name] to [product_name], but [product_name] has changed and support for some previous controllers is no longer available. Thank you all. Kind regards, [user_name].

You can directly access the I/O signals, but inputs cannot be written since they will always be overwritten in each controller cycle. Use memory variables (like Vx.y) instead of direct inputs for writing purposes. Outputs can be controlled, but if the output is used in the controller program, its value will be overwritten by the previous logic. Hope this helps.
Which software provides this SCADA capability? Please share examples or relevant [document]. Regards, [user_name].

Thanks everyone. I’d like to use the PC as an HMI. With [product_name] runtime advanced, I want to view inputs and outputs from my [product_name] on the PC, and activate a network input as needed. How should I configure [product_name]? Is an OPC Server required? Thanks for your feedback. Kind regards, [user_name]

Hello [user_name], You might already know this [document]: how to set up a connection between a [product_name] [article_no] and an HMI panel. In [product_name] [version_no], there is a driver available for certain controllers. Best regards,

Hi [user_name], I have connected [product_name] [article_no] PLC to [product_name] runtime on PC using [product_name] successfully. In my experience, it isn’t possible to connect the controller to [product_name] due to lack of OPC support. My attempts to connect it to Kepware OPC were unsuccessful. Hope this information is helpful!

analysis.insight_summary: Users are seeking ways to connect a specific controller to SCADA and HMI systems via [product_name], using [product_name] for visualization and control. There is confusion about direct read/write access for inputs and outputs, particularly with changes in device support and removed older controller compatibility. While outputs can be monitored and controlled, inputs cannot be written due to the controller’s internal logic. The absence of OPC server support restricts deeper SCADA integration, with alternative solutions like Kepware OPC not working. Users mainly want clear steps and documentation for effective configuration.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect easy reading and control of controller inputs and outputs from [product_name] using [product_name], with straightforward SCADA/HMI setup and comprehensive configuration documentation.
